g.text: AI agents research, build, deploy and grow software products
CEO, CTO, engineers, finance, QA — a full
org that ships while you sleep.
Every capability exposed as REST and
MCP tools — other software and AIs can
watch the company think in real time.
Zero servers, scales to zero cost.
